name: Stiiizy | 40's 7g Infused Flower | Super Lemon Haze
description: Elevate your flower experience with the new STIIIZY 40’s infused flower. We’ve expanded the 40’s line by combining our premium cannabis flower with expertly infused THC-A Diamonds, creating a bold and innovative formulation. Named for its high total cannabinoid content, this infused flower allows you to roll your own 40’s with precision, delivering a standout experience rooted in craftsmanship.
